(2) Across the ENTIRE served json/ prefix -- 954 keys, 1 page, terminal IsTruncated=False -- 0 keys contain 'cotton', 'cot/', '/cot', 'tenant' or 'scoped' (case-insensitive). ⛔ PAGINATION NOTE, because the criterion turns on it: the CLI's auto-paginate MERGES pages and DROPS IsTruncated/NextToken, so the very field this criterion asks me to show is the one auto-paginate removes, and KeyCount reads absent for every prefix. Each page was therefore fetched with --no-paginate and the loop terminates ONLY on IsTruncated==False -- exhaustion PROVEN, not assumed. --max-items and head appear nowhere in the probe. ⛔ SUBSTRING TRAP, caught and reported rather than silently counted: token 'firm' returned 2 hits, both FALSE -- it matched inside 'mullin-confirmation-hearing.json'. acceptance.output_evidence: ANSWER: YES, IT DISTINGUISHES THEM TODAY -- but incidentally at the transport layer, not by any empty contract, and the MISSING branch is LOSSY. All citations @portal 4a52439cbe. MISSING KEY: portal-proxy.ts:94 `if (!response.ok) {` -> :112 `throw new Error(\`API request failed: ${response.status} ${response.statusText} - ${errorBody}\`)`. A non-ok response THROWS, so a missing key lands in React Query's error state (queryFn: getPositioningData at ModelPortfolioModal.tsx:134 and Attribution.tsx:36). EMPTY ARTIFACT: :115 `return response.json()` resolves, then :1133 hands portfolios to canonicalizeCodeKeys, whose :42 is `if (!rec) return rec` -- an empty or absent portfolios map returns harmlessly and does NOT throw. So EMPTY -> success state with no data; MISSING -> error state. Different consumer states, therefore distinguishable. ⛔ THE QUALIFICATION, WHICH IS THE PART WORTH READING: the discrimination is a BYPRODUCT of `!response.ok`, not a designed contract. The MISSING branch collapses into ONE undifferentiated Error string that also carries auth failure, expired token and edge errors; nothing downstream can tell 'this firm has no data' from 'your token expired'. And per a served-plane control recorded at :1099-1100 a NONEXISTENT PATH returns 401, not 404, because auth is enforced before path resolution -- so MISSING is indistinguishable from UNAUTHENTICATED at the consumer. ⚠ THAT 401 CLAUSE IS RELAYED, NOT RE-DERIVED BY ME: it is 0.0.0_AB_MSTR~Z's measurement recorded in that docstring, and a docstring gives sufficient not necessary conditions. Re-measuring it needs a live bearer against the distribution, which is outside a read-only substrate TO. Marked relayed rather than folded into my own evidence. NOTE FOR PT-c-2's PRODUCER HALF: there is no explicit-empty contract to observe because no producer emits one -- that half does not exist yet.

mutant.description: The controls here are POSITIVE CONTROLS ON ABSENCE, which is the shape this TO's evidence actually needs -- three of the four criteria turn on something NOT being there, and a failed retrieval is byte-identical to a true absence. (1) SAME-PROBE control: the identical list_all() call that returns 0 Cottonwood keys returns 3 keys on the served prefix. (2) SCALE control: the same call returns 11,847 keys over 12 pages against a per-firm bucket, so multi-page exhaustion is exercised and not merely assumed from a 1-page case. (3) SAME-BUCKET control: Cottonwood's own home returns 6,599 objects, so the absence is not credential-blindness or an empty bucket. (4) DISCRIMINATING PAIR at head-object: model.json 404 vs positioning_data.json 200 on one bucket, one prefix, one command form. (5) RETRIEVAL-FAILURE ARM built into the instrument: list_all() returns a distinct RETRIEVAL-FAILED outcome on any non-zero rc, so a broken read can never be rendered as an absence -- the failure mode is separated from the finding by construction rather than by care.
mutant.expected: (1) non-empty. (2) non-empty, multi-page, terminal IsTruncated=False. (3) non-empty. (4) 404 and 200 respectively. (5) no arm returned RETRIEVAL-FAILED.
mutant.observed: (1) 3 keys. (2) 11,847 keys, 12 pages, IsTruncated=False. (3) 6,599 keys, 7 pages, IsTruncated=False. (4) rc=254/404 and rc=0/8088 bytes. (5) 0 of 5 probes returned RETRIEVAL-FAILED. All as expected.

determinism.method: The served Positioning prefix was listed TWICE in one run as two independently-labelled probes (AC1-a and AC2-a), issued as separate subprocess calls.
determinism.observed: Both returned the identical 3 keys, 1 page, IsTruncated=False. NOT a strong determinism claim and not offered as one: S3 listings are live state and a write between the two calls would legitimately change them. It establishes call-level repeatability within the run, nothing about stability over time.

surprises: OBSERVATION / INERT -- LATENT, NOT LIVE, and the caller check is what demoted it. The client fetches /api/general/positioning/model.json at portal-proxy.ts:1381, comp-routes resolves it to s3://opal-data-portal-v2/json/positioning/model.json on the same behavior and rewrite as the keys that DO exist, and head-object returns HTTP 404 (rc=254) against a positive control that returns 200. So a served key referenced by client code does not exist. ⛔ I ALMOST REPORTED THIS AS A LIVE BREAKAGE. getModelData has ZERO call sites: 2 code occurrences across 1069 tracked portal files, both in portal-proxy.ts (the definition :1379 and the barrel export :2450), every other hit a doc file; negative control on getPositioningData returns many. The portal's own docs record the call being deliberately removed for performance -- etl/OPTIMIZED_JSON_STRUCTURE.md:387 and etl/IMPLEMENTATION_SUMMARY.md:414 both say 'Remove getModelData() call' against a 16 MB PKL costing 5+ seconds. So the consumer was retired on purpose, the key went with it, and an exported wrapper was left behind. Not a defect today; it becomes one the moment anything calls the exported function, which would land on exactly the MISSING path AC3 describes. Also worth one line: the docstring at :1371 says 'Lambda: Checks X-User-Tier header', which reads as a different origin and would have explained the absence benignly -- comp-routes shows it resolving to the same S3 origin as its neighbours, so the rival was checked and excluded rather than assumed away. Surfaced to 3.0.0_SA_CVO~Z cc 2.0.0_SA_COO~Z. No action taken.
